dataset: duelmasters.editioncompass.com — New Division daily encounter readings
what_this_is: Readings this site took from the daily New Division encounter-survey charts, which are published as images. One row per survey day. See DATA.md for the schema.

source.name: BEANS
source.how: Each day is published the following morning as a single pie-chart image. Values were read from the image; the game count is the survey’s own.

reproduction_note: This file is this site’s working record of its own readings, kept so that articles can be computed rather than re-read. It is not a republication of the source’s dataset: site pages quote only the few figures an article argues from, with attribution. Do not publish this file wholesale as a table.

conventions.completeness: "full" = every slice on that day’s chart is recorded. "tracked" = only the six columns this site tracked at the time, plus the leader. "full_suspect" = recorded as a full read but the slices do not sum to 100.0, so a slice was missed.
conventions.leading_named_deck: Largest named slice. The survey’s unnamed bucket (その他) is excluded. null when two entries tie.
conventions.families: Entries are recorded exactly as the chart labels them. Baraghiara and Magic Tools are split across entries on some days; totals are the reader’s job, not this file’s.
conventions.percentages: As printed on the chart. A "full" day sums to 100.0, except where rounding makes that impossible: on a small enough sample every slice is a whole number of games and rounding each to one decimal can leave the total short. 22 October 2026 sums to 99.6 for that reason and is correct as recorded. For such a day the check is reconstructing the game counts and matching the stated sample size, not the sum.
conventions.unresolved_labels: A slice whose chart label cannot be read at source resolution is recorded under a （判読不能） placeholder and listed in that day's label_unresolved. The percentage is real; the name is not known.

known_convention_differences.why: That page’s Magic Tools column is the single headline entry; this file records both entries, so the family total is higher. The page says so in its own caveats, and the week-two page names the 8.9/12.1 difference explicitly. This is intentional. Do not "correct" either one against the other.

This day's printed slices sum to 99.6. It is not a misread. At 46 games each slice is a whole number of games and the nineteen rounded percentages lose 0.4 between them; the counts reconstruct to exactly 46. Do not "correct" any figure on this day to make it total 100.0.

2026-10-22.note: Smallest day in the series by a wide margin, and only about eight hours of play: the game was down from 23:15 on the 21st until 16:00 on the 22nd. First day under the changed 《“B-零朱”レイド》 and the first day of the seventh にじさんじ collaboration, so it is a part-day on both counts and proves nothing about either. 19 slices and NO その他 entry — the first day in the series without one; at 46 games the survey names everything. The printed percentages sum to 99.6, not 100.0: every slice is a whole number of games out of 46 (8, 6, 3×3, 2×9, 1×5 = 46 exactly), and rounding each to one decimal loses 0.4 in total. The game-count reconstruction is the check that applies to this day, not the sum rule. ヘブンズキリコ is new to the series at 2.2, which is one game; the chart writes it without the middle dot the card 《神歌の天后 ヘブンズ・キリコ》 has. Do not read anything into a one-game entry.

2026-10-23.note: First full day under the changed 《“B-零朱”レイド》; the maintenance ended at 16:00 on the 22nd. 赤白レイド is NOT a named slice on this chart — the first day of the series it is missing. Below the survey's cutoff a deck sits in the unnamed bucket (13.4 here), so this is not absence from the format. 赤白轟轟轟(レイド無し), the build the chart names without that card, is second at 11.9 against a previous series high of 3.6. One day proves nothing on its own — see the Jokers run of 11.4, 26.5, 14.3, 22.7, 20.8 with nothing changed in the game — but the streak ending is a fact: see below. Re-read independently on 24 October, after the card-change page cited it: the chart was rendered on a full white viewport at a size that fits whole, and shows ELEVEN labels and eleven wedges — seven on the left, four on the right — with 赤白レイド among none of them. The first reading used a transparent probe with a page sidebar overlapping the right edge, which could have hidden a label; it did not, but only the whole-chart view proves that. 赤単轟轟轟(レイド無し) at 2.6 and 赤白轟轟轟(レイド無し) at 11.9 were each magnified at a 1600px render to separate 単 from 白.

2026-10-27.leading_named_deck: 赤白轟轟轟(レイド無し)
2026-10-27.note: Fifth full day under the changed 《“B-零朱”レイド》 and the fifth running with 赤白レイド not a named slice. Whole-chart method on a full white viewport: ten labels, ten wedges, sums to exactly 100.0. Both 轟轟轟 labels magnified at a 1700px render: 赤白轟轟轟(レイド無し) 22.7 and 赤単轟轟轟(レイド無し) 3.6. 赤白轟轟轟(レイド無し) LEADS OUTRIGHT for the first time and sets a series high at 22.7, against a previous high of 16.6 on the 25th; it tied for the lead on the 25th but had not led alone. CAUTION: 110 games is a small sample. Only 46 (22 October) and 84 (19 October) are smaller among the full reads, and 110 ties 20 October exactly, so this is the joint third-smallest. 22.7 is about 25 games and the smallest named slice, 2.7, is about 3. Nine decks are named plus the bucket. That is the series minimum, but it is a FIVE-WAY tie: 3, 11, 17 and 18 October also name nine, so the right phrasing is 'as few as the chart has ever named', not 'the fewest since' any date. コットンゼニス and ヘブンズキリコ are both absent after appearing on the 26th. Both superlatives in the first version of this note were wrong and were caught by recomputing against the whole series before publishing: it said second-smallest sample (it is joint third) and fewest named decks since 11 October (18 October also named nine).

This completes week five, 22-28 October: all seven days read. Six of them sum to 100.0 and the 22nd is the documented 99.6 rounding exception, so a week-wide sum statement has to say six and one, not seven.
